name: This Game is Self-Aware
source:
What happens when you grant your characters self-awareness? As it turns out, a lot of fun, complaining, meta references and a whole load of shenanigans! (and maybe even a sprinkle of romance?)

Mess around with our disgruntled 'hero' in this irreverent and cheeky take on pop-culture, chock-full of references and fourth-wall demolition.

Try to navigate through every possibility and grab all ten achievements!

[From [url=https://lukaskrew.itch.io/this-game-is-self-aware]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你赋予角色自我意识时会发生什么？事实证明，有很多乐趣、抱怨、元引用和一大堆恶作剧！（甚至可能还有一点浪漫？）在这个充满不敬和厚颜无耻的流行文化中与我们心怀不满的“英雄”一起玩耍，充满了参考文献和第四堵墙的拆除。

尝试探索每一种可能性并获得全部十项成就！

[来自[url=https://lukaskrew.itch.io/this-game-is-self-aware]itch.io[/url]]
